video_title: A Fifth Ring Would Change EVERYTHING For Steph + Duncan vs. KG Isn’t CLOSE

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's legacy if he wins a fifth championship
quotes.excerpt: If Steph wins his fifth chip with this team, we're going to have a very tough conversation.
quotes.quote: If Steph wins his fifth chip and Bron retires with four, would it boost Steph's legacy more or hurt Bron's legacy more? Steph has been challenging Magic for the GOAT PG spot and his fifth would put him on equal footing in terms of championships. Every great player relevant in the GOAT debate has won the most championships in their era and LeBron would be the first one to win less. The last part of that sentence is not true. There are players who have won six, seven, eight, nine championships who are not in the GOAT debate. If Steph wins his fifth chip with this team, we are going to have a very, very tough conversation about where Stephen Wardell Curry is in the history books. If he wins this year, he is going to have to be in that conversation with the big boys. That is crazy. A fifth with this team that he has this year with no center? Oh yeah.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's potential to win an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: Luka is on a generational tear. I am impressed by this team, their continuity, their energy.
quotes.quote: Luka is on a generational tear. I have tweeted it. I am impressed by this team, their continuity, their energy. I am impressed by how guys step up even when he is not there, Austin Reaves. I am impressed by how simple they have made Walker Kessler's role and he just stars in that role and so does everyone else. We are ten games into the season. We are not even twenty-five games into the season. No one ever, ever has had a season like this. Also, Jalen Brunson did not win a championship until the ball went to KAT. This is a fact. Mike Brown changed their offense so that Jalen Brunson's usage was less so that in the fourth quarter he could kill. They gave the ball to KAT. Luka is a better scorer, passer, and playmaker because he is 6'9" and he is in shape. Luka is amazing.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson's performance and recent shooting slump
quotes.excerpt: He went through a slump, the first four games of the season with a brand new team.
quotes.quote: He went through a slump, the first four games of the season with a brand new team, a brand new offense, with brand new players. I think they have four or five new players, including Giannis Antetokounmpo. And now he is shooting the ball like crazy. Well, that is crazy. Oh, because he is a winner, he is a champion, and he is adjusting to their offense, he is adjusting to how people are playing Giannis Antetokounmpo. What do we expect? We do not expect anything less. But we are eleven games into the season. Give it twenty-five before you start screaming for the mountaintops. This guy is great, or this guy sucks, or this guy is going to be MVP. Let us calm down and let us, you know, Klay is a great player. He is going to be good, but it is an 82-game season. They played eleven.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's longevity and obsession with basketball
quotes.excerpt: I think Kevin Durant is one of those guys that can play as long as his body holds up.
quotes.quote: I think Kevin Durant is one of those guys that can play as long as his body holds up. And I just think Kevin Durant is such a hooper. If he did not play, he would probably play 3-on-3. If he does not play 3-on-3, he is playing 1-on-1 in his backyard. He is obsessed with basketball and you love to see it. So hopefully his body keeps up with him.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves' outlook without Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: You have to. You do not have a choice. Just be tough six. There are injuries everywhere.
quotes.quote: You have to. You do not have a choice. Just be tough six. There are injuries everywhere. LaMelo Ball is impressive this year, early. The way he plays is energetic and it is fun and unselfish. And so, I am pretty sure they are going to stay within playoff realm and be good.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Lakers should not have traded for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if Jaylen Brown in his mind thinks he's a number two. Austin Reaves knows he's a number two.
quotes.quote: I don't know if Jaylen Brown in his mind thinks he's a number two. Austin Reaves knows he's a number two. I think in the playoffs, you need guys that think they're number one equally in different ways, but during the regular season, you got to have a pecking order. I don't know if Austin Reaves ever goes on a court and thinks, 'Yeah, I'm the best player out here.' I think he goes, 'Oh, that guy is really good. I'm going to get 25 because the best defender is on that guy and I'm really good also.' So, no, I don't think it would have worked.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's five most underrated players of all time
quotes.excerpt: David West, Dirk Nowitzki, Chris Bosh, Amar'e Stoudemire, Zach Randolph. Those are my five most underrated.
quotes.quote: David West, Dirk Nowitzki, Chris Bosh, Amar'e Stoudemire, Zach Randolph. Those are my five most underrated. And you know what? Take Dirk Nowitzki off, that's too easy. Chris Kaman. How about that? Elton Brand. How about that? They used to get buckets, buckets.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of the NBA's second apron rules
quotes.excerpt: If a player is drafted, you have to reward teams for not having dumbass GMs.
quotes.quote: I just feel like in the second apron, if a player is drafted, you have to reward teams for not having dumbass GMs. So if you get drafted by that team, you should be able to stay on that team. Reward the team for drafting well and having a culture to keep their players. Like think about Oklahoma City. They are drafting these dudes and going, 'Damn, I got them three years, I got to get rid of them because we are in the apron.' If you draft them, you should be able to keep them.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Ideal teammates for a first-option player
quotes.excerpt: Give me LeBron James, Victor Wembanyama, OG Anunoby, Naz Smith or Jalen McDaniels, and Taurean Prince.
quotes.quote: Give me LeBron James, Victor Wembanyama, OG Anunoby, Naz Reid or Jalen McDaniels, and Taurean Prince. Any one of those mix, I am good to go. I am getting buckets.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Sacrificing individual stats for team success
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is in the business of letters, not numbers, meaning wins and losses.
quotes.quote: Not every style of play equates to winning. Certain guys can get 30 and their team would lose every single night. The NBA is in the business of letters, not numbers, meaning wins and losses. Not numbers, meaning, 'Oh, you are averaging 25.' People got to score, but the way that you play, is it conducive to winning? Right? Here is an example, Darius Garland. My guy is averaging, what is he averaging, 25 points right now? 26. So he is averaging 26 and their team is losing almost every single night. So is that a Darius Garland problem or is that a what is built around Darius Garland? Right? Okay, think about Jalen Brunson or Anthony Edwards. They go, 'Hey, you are scoring all the time. You are successful, but we cannot win until we take the ball out of your hands and everyone else is a threat too.' Having one sniper is different than having five. So you have to empower a team. And a lot of guys think that like, 'Oh, because I am not averaging 26, it is because those are bad 26. Those are rice cake 26.' You got to score that equates to winning. And then you can score all the points you want.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The decline of the traditional big man
quotes.excerpt: If you are good on the block, there is going to double team you every single time.
quotes.quote: If you are good on the block, there is going to double team you every single time. Then you got to be an elite passer. If the greatest big man passer of all time does not post up every time, then it is a bad, it is efficiently bad. If you think about that. So, oh, let me give the ball to Jared Allen who has a 6'5" guy on him. Oh, guess what, we are going to double team him and make him pass over 6'9", 6'10", 6'7", 7-foot. Like it is a stupid play. So you play with the ball facing the hoop as much as possible and get downhill. And anybody big, they are just going to go small. It is a small ball era.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Duncan versus Kevin Garnett debate
quotes.excerpt: Tim Duncan, not even close. Not even close. This shouldn't even be a debate.
quotes.quote: Tim Duncan, not even close. Not even close. This shouldn't even be a debate on any level ever in the history of mankind. Tim Duncan, Kevin Garnett is great. Tim Duncan is the greatest player at his position ever. He is a top-five player in the history of basketball, in my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's nutria problem in Oregon
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't a beaver, it was a nutria, and yeah, listen, look, nutria are an invasive species.
quotes.quote: It wasn't a beaver, it was a nutria, and yeah, listen, look, nutria are an invasive species and I did good for nature. Just call me Captain Planet, but you know, look, click-clack, sometimes you got to get gangster on things, you know? Pew-pew.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's first memories of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: My first memories were going to Phoenix Suns games, a lot like a lot of other players.
quotes.quote: I have wanted to be in the NBA since I was in second grade, since I figured out I was really tall. And then my first memories were going to Phoenix Suns games, a lot like a lot of other players. I remember my dad came late to the game, lied to the parking lot attendant, showed him a pager that did not work, and said, 'I am a doctor and I need to park really close because I am on call, but I promised my son I would take him to a game.' We had the highest seats possible, and I remember watching guys like Charles Barkley and Dan Majerle and those and, you know, Elliot Perry from a long time ago and it was great. The NBA basketball is just gorgeous. It is just such a gorgeous game.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The 2014 Phoenix Suns' missed playoff opportunity
quotes.excerpt: They didn't resign me after 2014. That's why I went to Orlando.
quotes.quote: They did not resign me after 2014. That is why I went to Orlando. So Goran Dragic was second team All-NBA that year. We won 48 games, missed the playoffs. It was a tragedy. We were a good young team, and I felt like we should have brought it. It was Goran, myself, Gerald Green, Miles Plumlee, um, Bledsoe should have came back, he was great, uh, P.J., I think Jared Dudley was still on the team, and the Morris twins. We were a very solid team. We should have just kept rolling with that. But people make decisions, stuff happens.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.excerpt: Stop making excuses about what everybody else isn't doing, whether the coach isn't doing this.
quotes.quote: Stop making excuses about what everybody else is not doing, whether the coach is not doing this. Go in there and do your job and do it the best you can. If you have that approach, then you are more present and then you are more active. If it is your job to rebound, you rebound. If your job to run, run. If your job to screen, screen. Do not say, 'Well, he did not do this,' or 'He ain't doing that,' or 'I am, you know, I don't coach so I want me to do.' That is a lot of excuses. Just do your job and good things will happen.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.excerpt: If I don't get an opportunity to shoot the basketball because guys are getting double teamed.
quotes.quote: If I don't get an opportunity to shoot the basketball because guys are getting double teamed or the rotations are bad, especially in the playoffs, I am taking advantage of that. And then watching in film, I noticed that their rotations were slow and then the guys that were rotating to me were below 6'7". So if you are below 6'7", you are not even close to where my release is and barbecue chicken.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Favorite Snapchat story from the Cavaliers days
quotes.excerpt: I know the most famous one is when Richard buckled little Kevin on the front seat.
quotes.quote: I know the most famous one is when Richard buckled little Kevin on the front seat and made me sit in the backseat. But then after he took the video, I ripped the, ripped little Kevin up and sat in the front seat like a grown man, but I just did it for the cameras.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's preferred sports outside of basketball
quotes.excerpt: Tennis, no contact, in shape, most of the time the weather is good.
quotes.quote: Tennis, no contact, in shape, most of the time the weather is good, and, you know, it was tennis is great, tennis is fun. Or golf. Golf is tight too.
